EN.name: No entry for cars and motorcycles without sidecar
EN.description: This sign indicates that both cars and motorcycles are prohibited from passing. It is used in residential areas or roads designated only for bicycles or pedestrians.

FR.name: Accès interdit aux voitures et motos sans side-car
